tasks.title: Create the implementation workspace and pin dependencies
tasks.work: Create a minimal Rust workspace, record toolchain and compatible dependency choices, enable fmt/clippy/core tests. Do not create placeholder implementations for every platform.
tasks.exit_criterion: A clean checkout builds the selected spike target; lockfile and actual version choices are recorded.

tasks.title: Detect the actual Ubuntu session and capability surface
tasks.work: Add diagnostic probing for active session, outputs, available protocols, shortcut portal, and failure reasons. Keep unknown distinct from unavailable.
tasks.exit_criterion: A doctor report from the real machine identifies the native backend and states what was not probed.
tasks.remaining: The GlobalShortcuts portal interface is still unprobed: no D-Bus client dependency has been chosen. X11 probing beyond socket reachability is T005. Windows and macOS have no probe.

tasks.title: Prove the Windows overlay path
tasks.work: Build only the transparent surface, fixed ink, one-stroke input, mode switching, and exit controls. Check empty transparent hit testing and other-process clicks.
tasks.exit_criterion: Native Windows evidence records success/failure for live overlay, no click leakage, visible pass-through, and withdrawal.

tasks.title: Prove the macOS overlay path
tasks.work: Evaluate the minimal winit/AppKit path, pointer transparency, focus policy, deactivation, and Spaces/fullscreen separately.
tasks.exit_criterion: Native macOS evidence records ordinary-app behavior and any Spaces/fullscreen restrictions.

tasks.title: Prove the composited X11 path
tasks.work: Validate transparency, stacking hints, pointer input shape, keyboard release, and activation on an actual X11 desktop.
tasks.exit_criterion: Native X11 evidence includes compositor/WM versions and no hidden keyboard grab.

tasks.title: Prove native layer-shell Wayland
tasks.work: Create a correctly assigned layer surface, configure/scale lifecycle, input-region switching, keyboard policy, and a portal or desktop-configured action.
tasks.exit_criterion: Recorded layer-shell environment passes the input fixture checks; missing protocols are reported, not faked.

tasks.title: Resolve the GNOME implementation route
tasks.work: Measure standalone xdg-shell behavior, then prototype the minimum companion only if needed. Record install, lifecycle, and Rust/helper boundaries.
tasks.exit_criterion: ADR-002 identifies a verified route or explicitly leaves full GNOME parity blocked. A limited fallback is not a pass.
tasks.remaining: The standalone route is measured and recorded. A GNOME Shell companion prototype now exists in integrations/gnome/ but has never been loaded by a running Shell: docs/evidence/E007 holds the checklist. ADR-002 stays open until it has a result.

tasks.title: Ratify architecture and support intent
tasks.work: Compare platform evidence; update ADRs and minimum tested environments. Decide full release versus an explicitly limited preview.
tasks.exit_criterion: The architecture and dependency set are evidence-backed; every claimed environment has a result, including failures/blocked states.

tasks.title: Implement the platform-free document model
tasks.work: Add typed output-local coordinates, object IDs, styles, vector objects, and document validation without GPU/OS dependencies.
tasks.exit_criterion: Headless tests cover valid objects, invalid numeric values, and independent output documents.
tasks.dependency_note: Amended by ADR-004 on 2026-09-23: was T008. ink-core is platform-free by constitution §3, so its contract cannot be invalidated by a backend decision. T008 remains the gate for support claims.
tasks.evidence: crates/ink-core/tests/document.rs, 16 headless tests; cargo fmt/clippy/test clean on 2026-09-23

tasks.title: Implement the pure interaction reducer
tasks.work: Add desired/effective modes, transient gesture states, transition IDs, cancellation, and typed effects.
tasks.exit_criterion: Table-driven tests cover each allowed transition, held-button rules, failure rollback, and stale completion events.
tasks.evidence: crates/ink-app/tests/reducer.rs, 25 headless tests including stale-transition and held-button cases; mutation-checked on 2026-09-23

tasks.title: Integrate production overlay lifecycle
tasks.work: Connect the reducer to native adapters, surface ownership, focus/hit-test changes, and confirmed completion events.
tasks.exit_criterion: The native fixture validates effective-state reporting and no invisible blockers.
tasks.remaining: Built and smoke-tested; on-screen behaviour not yet observed. Always on Top is manual and the output cannot be chosen (E002, E003).

tasks.title: Implement activation, CLI control, and recovery
tasks.work: Register approved global actions with conflict feedback; add local single-user CLI IPC and settings/launcher recovery. Respect native event-loop ownership.
tasks.exit_criterion: Activation works while another app is focused; denied/conflicting bindings are visible; no-tray operation and EmergencyHide are demonstrated.
tasks.remaining: The GlobalShortcuts portal is not implemented and no D-Bus dependency is chosen. A user-bound desktop chord is untested. Shortcut conflict feedback and a non-terminal launcher/recovery path do not exist.

tasks.title: Implement the independent compact toolbar
tasks.work: Wire toolbar actions through AppCommand. Distinguish canvas/toolbar hit testing and keep toolbar hidden in default PassThrough.
tasks.exit_criterion: Toolbar click/drag never creates a stroke; no click-through surface contains a falsely interactive control.
tasks.remaining: Not observed on screen. Icons are drawn as paths and have no rendering tests; accessibility labels and keyboard navigation are NFR-006 and T030.

tasks.title: Implement transparent scene rendering
tasks.work: Add the selected compatible renderer, explicit alpha convention, scene caches, and demand-driven redraw.
tasks.exit_criterion: Blank background is genuinely transparent; unchanged scenes do not continuously redraw; highlighter edge behavior has a test fixture.
tasks.note: Software renderer retained deliberately: architecture.md warns against a second renderer before the first is profiled. Geometry caching deferred to T024 for the same reason. NFR-001 latency is unmeasured.

tasks.title: Add pen and highlighter tools
tasks.work: Implement transient sampling, dot creation, preview, commit/cancel, width/color/opacity, and bounded point storage.
tasks.exit_criterion: One gesture creates one object; canceled gestures produce no history; highlighter self-overlap has no mesh seam.
tasks.remaining: On-screen use of the highlighter and the style keys has not been observed; only the headless rules and the pixel fixtures are verified.

tasks.title: Add line, arrow, rectangle, and ellipse
tasks.work: Implement shared drag lifecycle, preview geometry, explicit degenerate-shape thresholds, and style reuse.
tasks.exit_criterion: Each completed shape creates one object; canceled/degenerate operations do not create invisible edits.
tasks.remaining: Not observed on screen; only the headless rules and pixel fixtures are verified.

tasks.title: Implement object erasing and command history
tasks.work: Add swept-geometry hit testing, grouped deletion, inverse commands, redo branching, clear, and history budgets.
tasks.exit_criterion: The drawing-history spec sequence passes headlessly with exact document restoration.
tasks.evidence: crates/ink-core/tests/history.rs (12 tests, including the spec core sequence verbatim); crates/ink-app/tests/tools.rs
tasks.remaining: Not observed on screen. The 64 MiB history byte budget is not enforced; only the 1,000-transaction count is (T024).

tasks.title: Complete selected-output and DPI behavior
tasks.work: Support output selection and output-local document switching. Normalize native coordinate scale and rotation once at the boundary.
tasks.exit_criterion: The same logical stroke aligns under tested scales; switching outputs preserves documents and does not assume a global Wayland cursor.

tasks.title: Build capability/settings UX
tasks.work: Show effective support state, errors, shortcuts, tool preferences, and compatibility-mode labeling.
tasks.exit_criterion: Unavailable operations are clearly disabled/explained; unknown results do not become green supported badges.

tasks.title: Implement explicit vector save
tasks.work: Serialize the versioned scene and apply bounded, failure-safe same-directory writes with platform-specific replacement.
tasks.exit_criterion: Save/reopen roundtrip works and disk/access/interruption faults preserve the previous valid file.
tasks.evidence: crates/ink-storage/tests/roundtrip.rs (19 tests); live save and load against a running overlay on 2026-09-23
tasks.remaining: One fixed session path; a file picker needs the desktop file portal. Atomic replacement is POSIX rename; Windows needs ReplaceFileW and has no backend to test it (T031). Output remapping reports a mismatch but offers no remap UI (T019).

tasks.title: Implement validated load and output remapping
tasks.work: Stage validation/migration before document replacement; handle missing output bindings explicitly.
tasks.exit_criterion: Malformed, oversized, nonfinite, or newer-schema inputs leave the current document unchanged.
tasks.evidence: crates/ink-storage/tests/roundtrip.rs (19 tests); live save and load against a running overlay on 2026-09-23
tasks.remaining: One fixed session path; a file picker needs the desktop file portal. Atomic replacement is POSIX rename; Windows needs ReplaceFileW and has no backend to test it (T031). Output remapping reports a mismatch but offers no remap UI (T019).

tasks.title: Audit permissions, content logging, and network behavior
tasks.work: Run basic drawing with capture permissions denied; inspect logging/IPC/default settings and verify no unnecessary privilege or network dependency.
tasks.exit_criterion: Drawing remains usable offline without capture permission; diagnostics contain no annotation text, pixels, or raw key stream.

tasks.title: Exercise cancellation and recoverable failures
tasks.work: Inject mode failure, stale callbacks, surface loss, shortcut disconnect, and active-gesture cancellation.
tasks.exit_criterion: Interactive surfaces withdraw on recoverable failure and committed work remains intact; limitations of a fully hung process are documented.

tasks.title: Measure responsiveness and resource use
tasks.work: Run documented normal/stress scenes in release mode; record p50/p95/p99 submission delay, frame pacing, idle CPU, allocations, and memory.
tasks.exit_criterion: A reproducible report separates submission timing from photon latency and explains any missed proposed target.

tasks.title: Run the MVP acceptance matrix
tasks.work: Execute domain/contract/native scenarios for every promised environment. Report real failures, untested hardware, and support restrictions.
tasks.exit_criterion: All advertised MVP environments have passing evidence; GNOME cannot be silently omitted from a full-support claim.

tasks.title: Add simultaneous outputs
tasks.work: Create independent surfaces/documents per output and implement an explicit stroke boundary policy.
tasks.exit_criterion: Cross-output input cannot jump coordinates; mixed-DPI surfaces keep separate correct transforms.

tasks.title: Handle output and desktop lifecycle
tasks.work: Handle unplug/reconnect, scale/rotation changes, lock/unlock, suspend/resume, and workspace movement using native lifecycle events.
tasks.exit_criterion: No ghost input surfaces or silent document loss occur in the lifecycle test matrix.

tasks.title: Add text entry and editing
tasks.work: Implement explicit text focus, Unicode/IME preedit and commit/cancel, and history for text edits. Object selection, move, resize and delete were split out into T036 on 2026-09-23 and are implemented.
tasks.exit_criterion: IME tests and local shortcuts work without leaking keystrokes to the underlying app while editing.
tasks.evidence: crates/ink-app/tests/text.rs (33 tests, including preedit, commit and delete-surrounding); zwp_text_input_v3 confirmed bound on the E001 machine
tasks.remaining: Not tried against a live input method: no evidence that composing Hindi or CJK actually produces the right text on screen. No caret movement within a run, no selection inside text, and no re-editing of a committed object.

tasks.title: Object selection, move, resize and delete
tasks.work: Split from T028 on 2026-09-23. Selection picking, move and scale transforms as inverse commands, corner handles, delete, and a live drag preview. Text and IME stay in T028.
tasks.exit_criterion: Selecting, moving, resizing and deleting are each one undoable edit that restores geometry exactly, and a click that does not move records no history.
tasks.remaining: Not observed on screen. Picking uses bounding boxes, not exact geometry. No multi-select, and no rotation.

tasks.title: Add annotation-only PNG/SVG export
tasks.work: Render/serialize the vector document without capturing desktop pixels; preserve alpha and use safe escaped SVG output.
tasks.exit_criterion: Exports contain only ink, with stable dimensions/styles and no screenshot permission request.

tasks.title: Validate accessible controls
tasks.work: Add labels, keyboard navigation, visible focus, scalable controls, and platform accessibility integration for each certified UI path.
tasks.exit_criterion: A recorded keyboard/screen-reader walkthrough covers all toolbar/settings actions; unverified custom Wayland accessibility is stated.

tasks.title: Package and harden distribution
tasks.work: Choose exact targets, build installers/packages, review dependency licenses/unsafe code, and perform platform signing/notarization checks where applicable.
tasks.exit_criterion: Clean-machine installation and uninstall preserve user documents and show truthful permissions/support notes.

tasks.title: Certify V1 support
tasks.work: Run the full release matrix on real machines, including fullscreen/Spaces cases promised by the product.
tasks.exit_criterion: Every published support statement maps to evidence and all limitations are visible in release notes.

tasks.title: Specify and implement optional capture/freeze
tasks.work: Select native capture integrations, permission UI, frame lifetime, freeze input blocking, and cancellation behavior.
tasks.exit_criterion: Deny/revoke/cancel capture without breaking live drawing; freeze never controls stale underlying pixels.

tasks.title: Implement screenshot-plus-ink export
tasks.work: Prevent self-capture/duplicate ink, exclude toolbar, composite once with correct transforms, and clear captured pixels by default.
tasks.exit_criterion: A known fixture is exported with exactly one ink layer and no app controls; no background image is silently retained.

tasks.title: Add presenter enhancements one spec at a time
tasks.work: Write a focused spec for each chosen board/laser/spotlight/pressure feature before implementation. Separate passive global input monitoring from Draw-mode effects.
tasks.exit_criterion: Each new feature has its own capability/privacy contract and native tests; no universal pressure/global tracking claim is assumed.
